  - "Which conferences and schools produce draftees above expectation, by position? (Post 2)"

---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# ---- Packages, data connection and figure defaults -------------------------
# Load the project's functions straight from the checkout with pkgload; the
# repo is never installed (decision 0042). The site build sets CFB2NFL_ROOT,
# a local render finds the checkout from the working directory.
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
library(DBI)
library(dplyr)
library(duckdb)
library(ggiraph)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)

# One interaction style for every girafe figure: a clear hover pop, dimming
# of non-hovered marks, a dark tooltip, and toolbar zoom + PNG download.
set_girafe_defaults(
  opts_hover = opts_hover(
    css = "stroke:#111827;stroke-width:2.5px;filter:brightness(1.12);"
  ),
  opts_hover_inv = opts_hover_inv(css = "opacity:0.45;"),
  opts_tooltip = opts_tooltip(
    css = "background:#111827;color:#fff;padding:6px 9px;border-radius:5px;font-weight:bold;font-size:15px;"
  ),
  opts_zoom = opts_zoom(min = 1, max = 5),
  opts_toolbar = opts_toolbar(saveaspng = TRUE, position = "topright"),
  opts_sizing = opts_sizing(rescale = TRUE)
)

# thousands-separated and percent formatters for inline numbers
fmt <- function(x, digits = 0) {
  formatC(as.numeric(x), big.mark = ",", format = "f", digits = digits)
}
pct <- function(x, digits = 1) sprintf("%.*f%%", digits, 100 * x)

# ---- Named players (keyed on athlete id) -----------------------------------
# Key on athlete id, never name (recruiting ids collide, decision 0013).
subjects <- tibble::tribble(
  ~who           , ~cfb_athlete_id ,
  "Carson Wentz" , "2573079"       ,
  "Trey Lance"   , "4383351"       ,
  "Josh Allen"   , "3918298"       ,
  "Tyreek Hill"  , "3116406"
)

# ---- Load the tables -------------------------------------------------------
team_season <- dbReadTable(con, "team_season")
team_draft <- dbReadTable(con, "team_draft")
teams <- dbReadTable(con, "teams")
roster <- dbReadTable(con, "roster")
picks <- dbReadTable(con, "picks")
player_stats_seasons <- dbGetQuery(
  con,
  "SELECT DISTINCT playerId, season FROM player_stats"
)

tier_order <- c("Power", "Group of 5", "FCS and below")
tier_colors <- c(
  "Power" = "#1d4ed8",
  "Group of 5" = "#f59e0b",
  "FCS and below" = "#6b7280"
)
team_season <- team_season |>
  mutate(tier_label = factor(tier_label, levels = tier_order))
# Notre Dame is Power (decision 0003) though it plays as an FBS independent.

first_class <- 2014L # full observable careers (roster starts 2010)
last_season <- 2025L # the 2026 season is in progress
played <- filter(team_season, games_played > 0, season <= last_season)
n_played_2025 <- n_distinct(played$team[played$season == 2025L])

# Every pick in the 2014 to 2026 classes, by draft-day school, with the
# school's tier in its latest recorded season before the draft.
reused <- reused_ids(roster)
school_tier <- team_season |>
  filter(!is.na(tier_label)) |>
  transmute(
    collegeTeam = team,
    tier_season = season,
    tier = as.character(tier_label),
    conference
  )
traced_ids <- picks |>
  filter(
    !is.na(playerId),
    !playerId %in% reused,
    year >= first_class,
    year <= last_season + 1L
  ) |>
  inner_join(
    distinct(roster, playerId, season),
    by = "playerId",
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) |>
  filter(season < year) |>
  distinct(playerId) |>
  pull()
window_picks <- picks |>
  filter(year >= first_class, year <= last_season + 1L) |>
  left_join(
    school_tier,
    by = join_by(collegeTeam, closest(year > tier_season))
  ) |>
  mutate(
    traced = playerId %in% traced_ids,
    tier = coalesce(tier, "School not in the data")
  )
n_window <- nrow(window_picks)
star <- function(who) {
  filter(picks, playerId == subjects$cfb_athlete_id[subjects$who == who])
}
wentz <- star("Carson Wentz")
lance <- star("Trey Lance")
allen <- star("Josh Allen")
hill <- star("Tyreek Hill")
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
*Data as of the latest published release, retrieved 2026-10-31. Rosters
and stat lines start with the 2010 season; the 2026 season is still being
played, so every season-level exhibit stops at 2025, and draft counts cover
the classes of 2014 through 2026.*
:::

## 1. Introduction

In 2025, `r fmt(n_played_2025)` college programs played at least one
recorded football game, from Alabama and Ohio State down to Division III,
and this post maps how they are grouped, what the data records about each,
and how unevenly the NFL draft draws from them. The answers set up two
later posts: which schools produce draftees at each position, and whether
winning explains it.

## 2. Data

### 2.1 Teams are grouped into conferences, and conferences into three tiers

The table defines every term the post uses: a division is the NCAA level a
school is classified at, while a tier groups conferences by competitive
level, season by season, so a school that changes conference can change
tier without changing division.

```{r}
#| label: terms
tibble::tribble(
  ~Term                  , ~Meaning                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               ,
  "Division"             , "The NCAA level a school plays at: FBS (Football Bowl Subdivision, the top level), FCS (Football Championship Subdivision, the next level down), Division II, and Division III. This post groups Division II, Division III, and the few schools with no recorded division as 'Division II and below'." ,
  "Conference"           , "A league of schools that schedule each other and share a championship, such as the SEC or the Big Sky. A few FBS schools are independents and belong to no football conference."                                                                                                                      ,
  "Realignment"          , "Schools changing conference. A conference change here is an FBS school playing in a different conference, or as an independent, than in its previous FBS season."                                                                                                                                     ,
  "Tier"                 , "Our three-level grouping of conferences by competitive level, set season by season because schools change conferences."                                                                                                                                                                               ,
  "Power"                , "The top tier: the SEC, Big Ten, ACC, and Big 12; the Pac-12 through 2023 (the Pac-10 before 2011); the Big East through 2012; and Notre Dame."                                                                                                                                                        ,
  "Group of 5"           , "The rest of FBS: the American Athletic (from 2013), Conference USA, Mid-American, Mountain West, Sun Belt, Western Athletic (through 2012), the two-school Pac-12 from 2024, and the independents other than Notre Dame. The name counts five conferences, but the group has held five or six."       ,
  "FCS and below"        , "Every school outside FBS: the FCS (such as the Big Sky or Missouri Valley), Division II, and Division III."                                                                                                                                                                                           ,
  "Team-season"          , "One school in one season."                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ,
  "Roster player-season" , "One player listed on one school's roster in one season."                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ,
  "Stat line"            , "At least one recorded statistic (a carry, catch, tackle, or kick) for a player in a season."                                                                                                                                                                                                          ,
  "Position group"       , "The roster position, grouped: quarterback, running back (fullbacks included), receiver, tight end, offensive line, defensive line, linebacker, defensive back, and special teams. A roster with no position, or a generic one such as athlete, is 'Position not recorded'."                           ,
  "Draft class"          , "The players picked in one year's NFL draft; the class of 2016 was drafted in April 2016, after the 2015 college season."                                                                                                                                                                              ,
  "Draft-day school"     , "The college the NFL draft lists for a player."                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ,
  "Credited pick"        , sprintf("A draft pick traced to the last college roster the player was on before the draft. Carson Wentz was drafted from North Dakota State (%d, pick %d) but is on no roster in the data, so his pick is not credited.", wentz$year, wentz$overall)
) |>
  kable(caption = "Terms used throughout.")
```

## 3. Results

```{r}
#| label: s31-compute
#| output: false
fbs <- played |>
  filter(classification == "fbs") |>
  # the Pac-10 became the Pac-12 in 2011: a rename, not a move
  mutate(league = if_else(conference == "Pac-10", "Pac-12", conference))
moves <- fbs |>
  arrange(team, season) |>
  group_by(team) |>
  mutate(from = lag(league)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(!is.na(from), from != league)
n_moves <- nrow(moves)
n_movers <- n_distinct(moves$team)
fbs_n <- count(fbs, season, name = "teams")
fbs_2010 <- fbs_n$teams[fbs_n$season == 2010L]
fbs_2025 <- fbs_n$teams[fbs_n$season == 2025L]
n_conf_2025 <- n_distinct(
  fbs$league[fbs$season == 2025L & fbs$league != "FBS Independents"]
)
wave1 <- sum(moves$season %in% 2011:2014)
wave2 <- sum(moves$season %in% 2023:2024)
pac12_2024 <- sort(fbs$team[fbs$season == 2024L & fbs$league == "Pac-12"])
big_east_2012 <- fbs$team[fbs$season == 2012L & fbs$league == "Big East"]
big_east_to_acc <- sort(
  fbs$team[
    fbs$season == 2013L & fbs$team %in% big_east_2012 & fbs$league == "ACC"
  ]
)
big_east_to_aac <- sum(
  fbs$season == 2013L &
    fbs$team %in% big_east_2012 &
    fbs$league == "American Athletic"
)
conf_by_tier <- played |>
  filter(conference != "FBS Independents" | is.na(conference)) |>
  group_by(season, tier_label) |>
  summarise(conferences = n_distinct(conference), .groups = "drop")
g5_conf_range <- range(
  conf_by_tier$conferences[conf_by_tier$tier_label == "Group of 5"]
)
```

### 3.1 FBS grew from 120 to 136 teams, and 61 schools changed conference at least once

In 2013 the Big East's football schools went to the new American Athletic,
except `r big_east_to_acc[1]` and `r big_east_to_acc[2]`, who joined the
ACC, and in 2024 the Pac-12 broke up; the table counts teams and
conferences by tier around those two waves, the figure dates all
`r n_moves` conference changes, and the tile chart traces every school
that moved.

```{r}
#| label: s31-table
teams_by_tier <- count(played, season, tier_label, name = "teams")
sel <- c(2010L, 2012L, 2013L, 2014L, 2023L, 2024L, 2025L)
teams_by_tier |>
  left_join(conf_by_tier, by = c("season", "tier_label")) |>
  filter(season %in% sel) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = tier_label,
    values_from = c(teams, conferences)
  ) |>
  left_join(count(moves, season, name = "moved"), by = "season") |>
  transmute(
    Season = season,
    `Power teams` = teams_Power,
    `Power conferences` = conferences_Power,
    `Group of 5 teams` = `teams_Group of 5`,
    `Group of 5 conferences` = `conferences_Group of 5`,
    `FCS and below teams` = fmt(`teams_FCS and below`),
    `FBS conference changes` = coalesce(moved, 0L)
  ) |>
  kable(
    caption = "Teams that played at least one recorded game, and the conferences they played in, by tier, in seasons around the two waves of realignment. Conference counts leave out the FBS independents; conference changes include moves into and out of independence. FCS-and-below team counts jump in 2021 and 2022 as many more Division II and III games enter the data."
  )
```

dii_played <- played |>

```{r}
#| label: s32-compute
#| output: false
division_order <- c("FBS", "FCS", "Division II and below")
division_colors <- c(
  "FBS" = "#1d4ed8",
  "FCS" = "#0f766e",
  "Division II and below" = "#6b7280"
)
played_div <- played |>
  mutate(
    division = case_when(
      classification == "fbs" ~ "FBS",
      classification == "fcs" ~ "FCS",
      TRUE ~ "Division II and below"
    ),
    division = factor(division, levels = division_order)
  )
coverage <- played_div |>
  group_by(season, division) |>
  summarise(
    played = n(),
    with_stats = sum(has_stat_lines),
    with_roster = sum(n_roster > 0),
    depth = median(n_stat_players[has_stat_lines]),
    roster_size = median(n_roster[n_roster > 0]),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(share = with_stats / played, roster_share = with_roster / played)
cov_at <- function(s, d, col) {
  coverage[[col]][coverage$season == s & coverage$division == d]
}
fcs_pre <- coverage |> filter(division == "FCS", season <= 2020L)
fcs_post <- coverage |> filter(division == "FCS", season >= 2021L)
low <- coverage |> filter(division == "Division II and below")
fcs_lo <- pct(min(fcs_pre$share), 0)
fcs_hi <- pct(max(fcs_pre$share), 0)
fbs_depth_2015 <- cov_at(2015L, "FBS", "depth")
fbs_depth_2016 <- cov_at(2016L, "FBS", "depth")
fbs_roster_2015 <- cov_at(2015L, "FBS", "roster_size")
fbs_roster_2016 <- cov_at(2016L, "FBS", "roster_size")
```

### 3.2 Every FBS team has stat lines every season, every FCS team from 2021 but only 39% to 71% before, and Division II and below almost none

The table counts the teams that played and the teams with at least one
player stat line, by division and season, the line chart tracks that
share, and the tile chart shows every FCS team-season.

```{r}
#| label: s32-table
coverage |>
  mutate(cell = paste0(with_stats, " of ", played)) |>
  select(season, division, cell) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = division, values_from = cell) |>
  left_join(
    coverage |>
      filter(division == "FBS") |>
      select(season, depth, roster_size),
    by = "season"
  ) |>
  transmute(
    Season = season,
    `FBS teams with stat lines` = FBS,
    `FCS teams with stat lines` = FCS,
    `Division II and below teams with stat lines` = `Division II and below`,
    `FBS median players with a stat line` = depth,
    `FBS median roster size` = roster_size
  ) |>
  kable(
    caption = sprintf(
      "Teams with at least one player stat line, of the teams that played at least one recorded game, by division and season, 2010 to 2025, with the median FBS team's players with a stat line and roster size. From 2016 the stat records list about twice as many players per FBS team (a median of %d in 2015, %d in 2016) while roster sizes held level (%d and %d), so the change is in how many players the stat records include.",
      fbs_depth_2015,
      fbs_depth_2016,
      fbs_roster_2015,
      fbs_roster_2016
    )
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: s33-compute
#| output: false
# credited picks: players whose final college season was 2013 to 2025,
# approximately the draft classes of 2014 to 2026 (24 draftees are credited
# two or three seasons before their draft)
credited <- filter(
  team_draft,
  season >= first_class - 1L,
  season <= last_season
)
group_picks <- credited |>
  group_by(group = position_group) |>
  summarise(picks = sum(n_drafted), .groups = "drop")
roster_stat <- roster |>
  filter(season <= last_season) |>
  distinct(playerId, season, position) |>
  left_join(
    mutate(player_stats_seasons, has_stat = TRUE),
    by = c("playerId", "season")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    group = position_group(position),
    has_stat = coalesce(has_stat, FALSE)
  )
ol_cov <- roster_stat |>
  group_by(group) |>
  summarise(
    seasons = n(),
    with_stat = sum(has_stat),
    share = mean(has_stat),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  left_join(group_picks, by = "group") |>
  mutate(pick_share = picks / sum(picks)) |>
  arrange(share)
ol <- filter(ol_cov, group == "Offensive line")
others <- filter(
  ol_cov,
  !group %in% c("Offensive line", "Position not recorded")
)
```

### 3.3 Offensive linemen supply one in six credited draft picks, but only 6% of their roster seasons carry a stat line

Offensive linemen block rather than carry, catch, or tackle, so the table
and bar chart show them filling rosters but rarely the stat records, and
the dot chart shows the same gap for every roster position code.

```{r}
#| label: s33-table
ol_cov |>
  transmute(
    `Position group` = group,
    `Roster player-seasons` = fmt(seasons),
    `With a stat line` = fmt(with_stat),
    `Share with a stat line` = pct(share),
    `Credited draft picks` = fmt(picks),
    `Share of picks` = pct(pick_share)
  ) |>
  kable(
    caption = "Roster player-seasons and how many carry a stat line, 2010 to 2025, with credited draft picks for the classes of 2014 to 2026, by position group."
  )
```

### 3.4 Twenty-seven schools account for half of all draft picks

Every one of the `r length(fbs_teams_window)` schools that played FBS from
2013 to 2025 except `r fbs_without_pick` had a pick, yet the table, the curve, and the
ranked bars show the `r fmt(n_window)` picks of the 2014 to 2026 classes
piling up at a short list of schools. Josh Allen's Wyoming, which produced
the seventh pick of 2018, is No. `r wyo$rank` with `r wyo$picks` picks.

### 3.5 FCS-and-below schools sent 193 players to the draft, North Dakota State 15 of them, but rosters trace fewer than half

The table counts draft picks from FCS-and-below draft-day schools and how
many the rosters trace to a final college season (`r pct(small_traced, 0)`,
against `r pct(fbs_traced, 0)` for FBS schools), the bar chart ranks the
schools, and the scatter shows every pick. Tyreek Hill, a fifth-round pick
in `r hill$year`, came from Division II West Alabama.

  ) |>

## 4. Summary

The data sees all of FBS, the FCS fully only from 2021, and little below
it, and the draft draws half its picks from 27 schools.

```{r}
#| label: summary
tibble::tribble(
  ~Finding                                                   , ~Evidence                                                                                                                                                                                         ,
  "FBS grew, and realignment moved a large share of it"      , sprintf("%d FBS teams in 2010, %d in 2025; %d schools made %d conference changes.", fbs_2010, fbs_2025, n_movers, n_moves)                                                                        ,
  "Stat lines cover FBS fully and FCS fully from 2021"       , sprintf("Every FBS team every season; %s to %s of FCS teams before 2021, every one from 2021.", fcs_lo, fcs_hi)                                                                                   ,
  "Offensive linemen are drafted but rarely have stat lines" , sprintf("%s of offensive-line roster seasons have a stat line; linemen are %s of credited picks.", pct(ol$share, 0), pct(ol$pick_share, 0))                                                       ,
  "Half of all draft picks come from 27 schools"             , sprintf("Top %d: %s of %s picks; top 10: %s; every FBS school but %s had a pick.", half_n, pct(school_picks$cum_share[half_n]), fmt(n_window), pct(school_picks$cum_share[10]), fbs_without_pick) ,
  "Small schools produce picks the rosters often miss"       , sprintf("%d picks from FCS and below, %d from North Dakota State; %s traced to a roster.", nrow(small), nrow(ndsu), pct(small_traced, 0))
) |>
  kable(caption = "The findings and the numbers behind them.")
```

## 5. Discussion

::: {.callout-important}
Draft output is concentrated, but a raw pick count does not separate what a
school develops from how many players pass through it.

- The next post divides each school's picks by its players, position by
  position, counting every player on a roster rather than only those with a
  stat line, before calling any school a producer.
:::

::: {.callout-important}
The stat records miss offensive linemen, and the rosters miss many
small-school draftees.

- Counting from rosters keeps offensive linemen, who would nearly vanish
  from a count built on stat lines.
- Small-school rosters are too incomplete for team-by-team rates, so FCS and
  below enter the next posts as one group.
:::

```{r}
#| label: caveats-pin
#| output: false
fcs_roster_2021 <- cov_at(2021L, "FCS", "with_roster")
fcs_roster_2022 <- cov_at(2022L, "FCS", "with_roster")
credited_share <- mean(window_picks$traced)
uncredited <- filter(window_picks, !traced)
uncredited_small <- mean(!uncredited$tier %in% c("Power", "Group of 5"))
```

Several caveats bound these numbers. FCS rosters are incomplete before 2022
(`r fcs_roster_2021` FCS teams had a roster in 2021, all
`r fcs_roster_2022` that played in 2022), and Division II and below rosters
are nearly absent throughout. The FCS played most of its 2020 season in
spring 2021, which the data barely records, so 2020 is a gap below FBS. A
credited pick goes to the player's final college team, so a transfer counts
for his last stop. `r pct(credited_share)` of the `r fmt(n_window)` picks
are credited to a team; the rest, mostly from small schools, are on no
roster in the data.
